retrieval_skill.name: regime_stability_evidence
retrieval_skill.description: Retrieve evidence that distinguishes a persistent post-change operating regime from a temporary transition by combining regime-level interpretation with direct telemetry observations.
retrieval_skill.applicability: When forecasting whether a recent operational shift will continue, stop, or revert during a future window.
retrieval_skill.query_strategy: Search for authoritative summaries of the change and validated observations covering the relevant horizon; prioritize sources describing persistence, baseline stability, anomalies, and reversion signals.
retrieval_skill.verification_rule: Accept a stability claim only when regime-level evidence and direct observations agree, provenance is verifiable, the evidence applies to the required temporal window, and no anomaly or reversal evidence contradicts it.
